compress-pdf.How much smaller will my PDF get?: It depends on the source and setting. Image-heavy PDFs may shrink more than text-heavy or already optimized files. Check the actual file size, readability and any required document features before sending.
compress-pdf.How do I compress a PDF on iPhone?: Use the supported browser tool or PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge. Check the App Store and in-app offer for current access and purchase options.

watermark-pdf.How do I watermark a PDF on iPhone?: Use this browser tool or PDF Watermark & Stamp. Check the current App Store listing and purchase options for the iPhone workflow.

compress-audio.What file do I get back?: The browser audio compressor exports M4A with AAC audio. Actual size and quality depend on duration and encoding settings. Check playback in the destination.

mp3-to-m4a.Is M4A smaller than MP3?: Not necessarily. Size depends on the codec, total encoded bitrate and duration. Changing formats does not guarantee a smaller file or recover lost quality.
